comment: 48yo female, lifelong resident of Bangladesh arsenic-affected region (immigrated to Ukraine 2018), documented inorganic-arsenic drinking-water exposure from village tubewells well above WHO + US EPA 10 µg/L guideline (typical Bangladesh village wells 100-500 µg/L). Endemic high-arsenic groundwater region with documented cohort-level health impact. Urinary inorganic arsenic elevated on screening. Visible arsenicosis (mild palmar/plantar hyperkeratosis). Never-smoker. No personal arsenic-attributable malignancy diagnosis. Inorganic arsenic IARC Group 1 (Monograph 100C) — urothelial / bladder cancer (SCC histology over-represented in arsenic cohorts), lung cancer (smoking-independent), non-melanoma skin (BCC + SCC + Bowen's disease). Latency 10-40y. Engine fires RF-ENVIRONMENTAL-ARSENIC-WATER-PREVENTION (any_of: drinking_water_arsenic_gt_10_ug_per_l OR private_well_arsenic_untested OR urinary_inorganic_arsenic_elevated OR endemic_arsenic_region_residence_history) → routes to 2-track PreventionPlan: standard = continued exposure-source remediation reinforcement + urinalysis + cytology q1-2y bladder surveillance + dermatologic exam q12mo + lung-symptom awareness + smoking-cessation reinforcement (n/a here, lifelong never-smoker); aggressive = annual cystoscopy + earlier LDCT consideration. Validates v0.3 environmental pilot — Bangladesh sister case to existing rural-well example. Anchored DIS-UROTHELIAL + DIS-NSCLC + DIS-BCC.
